name: OpenClaw
short_desc: AI coding agent with browser + sandbox tools
author: OpenClaw
description: Run OpenClaw on your own infrastructure with a web UI, tool-using agents, browser support, and sandboxed code execution.

form_fields.label: OpenClaw Auth Token
form_fields.hint: Required to authenticate browser sessions to your OpenClaw backend.

form_fields.label: OpenAI API Key
form_fields.hint: Optional. Add if you want to use OpenAI models.

form_fields.label: Anthropic API Key
form_fields.hint: Optional. Add if you want to use Anthropic models.

form_fields.label: OpenRouter API Key
form_fields.hint: Optional. Add if you want to use OpenRouter models.

form_fields.label: Default Provider
form_fields.hint: Model provider selected for new sessions (for example: openai, anthropic, openrouter).

form_fields.label: Default Model
form_fields.hint: Provider and model in OpenClaw format, e.g. openai:gpt-4.1-mini.

form_fields.label: Disable Sandbox Containers
form_fields.hint: If enabled, OpenClaw will not run isolated tool containers.

form_fields.label: Sandbox Image
form_fields.hint: Docker image used for sandboxed tool execution.
